title: Claude Opus 5.5
summary: Claude Opus 5.5 is now available in Conductor!
html:
Claude Opus 5.5 is now available in Conductor!

Opus 5.5 performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 for most tasks and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5.
